old: - `lfuo-learning-review-guide-2024-decision-making.md`, US Forest Service (*Learning From Unintended Outcomes and Learning Review Implementation Guide*, 2024). Operationalisation of Dekker-tradition just-culture and human-factors thinking in incident-review form. Three foundational principles (Just Culture, Systems Thinking, Learning); four-tool ladder (AAR / RLS / FLA / Learning Review); Five Hows + Lessons Learned Analysis as the decision-reconstruction tool; explicit position against causal statements ("FLAs must avoid causal statements"), counterfactual reasoning, and recommendations as the default output of incident analysis in complex systems. Recognition-Primed Decision Making (Klein) as the default operational pattern. ETTO and risk-as-construct (Slovic via Kahneman) as the underlying tradeoff frame. Termination criterion is reckless-and-willful disregard (high bright-line threshold). Best paired with the NHS Just Culture Guide distillation (for the structured culpability decision tree) and the OpenStax Psychology distillation (for the cognitive-bias literature LFUO cites). **Public domain (17 USC §105) — no copyright propagation.**
new: - `lfuo-learning-review-guide-2024-decision-making.md`, US Forest Service (*Learning From Unintended Outcomes and Learning Review Implementation Guide*, 2024). Operationalisation of Dekker-tradition just-culture and human-factors thinking in incident-review form. Three foundational principles (Just Culture, Systems Thinking, Learning); four-tool ladder (AAR / RLS / FLA / Learning Review); Five Hows + Lessons Learned Analysis as the decision-reconstruction tool; explicit position against causal statements ("FLAs must avoid causal statements"), counterfactual reasoning, and recommendations as the default output of incident analysis in complex systems. Recognition-Primed Decision Making (Klein) and Principle 7's intuitive-action framing. ETTO and risk-as-construct (Slovic via Kahneman) as the underlying tradeoff frame. Termination criterion is reckless-and-willful disregard (or a serious criminal act). Best paired with the NHS Just Culture Guide distillation (for the structured culpability decision tree) and the OpenStax Psychology distillation (for the cognitive-bias literature LFUO cites). **Public domain (17 USC §105) — no copyright propagation.**
